title: Exact Evaluation of cos(pi/12)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the exact radical value of \cos(\pi/12) using a trigonometric difference formula.

steps.title: Decompose pi/12 as a Difference of Special Angles
steps.explanation: Express pi/12 as the difference pi/3 - pi/4 (or pi/4 - pi/6).
steps.why: Both pi/3 and pi/4 have known exact sine and cosine values.

steps.title: Apply the Cosine Difference Formula
steps.explanation: Expand using cos(A - B) = cos A cos B + sin A sin B.
steps.why: The cosine difference identity expresses cos(A - B) in terms of sines and cosines of A and B.

steps.title: Substitute Exact Values and Simplify
steps.explanation: Substitute the exact values and combine over the denominator 4.
steps.why: Multiplying numerators and denominators yields (sqrt(2) + sqrt(6))/4.
